messages:
maria: Quick ask — need a compact visual called the 'leadflow slab' for the inference-economics webinar next Tue. It should explain how inbound leads map to content paths (benchmark tile -> demo flow -> sales touch). One hero slide (16:9) + three social crop micro-tiles (square, story, hero). Keep copy snappy.

dan: Do we want an explainer diagram or a process flow?

maria: Prefer a hybrid — top row shows 3 intake sources (paid, organic webinar signups, demo requests) as small icons, then a central slab that shows routing rules (by score/region/plan) and outputs to: benchmark assets, personalized demo, and sales queue. Add small KPI callouts for latency & cost benefit bullet (we'll pull numbers from the benchmark doc).

dan: Got it. Can you drop the benchmark numbers and preferred brand colors here? Also any accessibility constraints?

maria: Benchmarks to call out: median latency 90ms (hosted), cost per 1k tokens delta ~ -22% vs naive; keep those as 1-line callouts. Brand: use Core Blue (#0A7BFF) + Slate Gray accents. Accessibility: WCAG AA contrast on text, font scale >=14px for body.

ari: For the three micro-tiles, we should test two headline variants: (A) 'Faster inference, lower spend' (B) 'Scale inference without surprises'. Which do you prefer?

maria: Use variant A for the webinar hero, B for social tiles.

celine: Design constraints noted. ETA: initial comps by EOD Friday. Question: do we need animated export (gif) for the hero?

maria: Yes — one micro-animation for webinar landing (fade + slight slide on the slab). Keep file size <2MB.

figma-bot: New Figma file created: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/leadflow-slab — initial frame + component library.

dan: I'll start with a grayscale wireframe in that file and tag you both. Two follow-ups: 1) do we want an editable version for sales (fields like region, SLA, model variant)? 2) Do legal/compliance need to pre-check the claims?

maria: 1) yes, include a single edit layer for sales (tooltip example). 2) Legal looped in — @celine please flag anything risky; claims are high-level.

celine: Will check this afternoon. If wording needs softening, I'll propose phrases. Also confirming that we can use the term 'inference economics' in public.

maria: confirmed.

ari: Quick CSS spec for assets: hero 1920x1080 PNG + MP4 10s 1080p, square 1080x1080 PNG, story 1080x1920 PNG. Export presets added to Figma.

dan: Noted. Will push first PNG comps to the file and @maria for review.

maria: Thanks — tagging copy owner @ari to add final headlines and CTA. :sparkles:

ari: Copy drop: "Ship inference that just works — predictable latency, smarter cost" + CTA: "See the benchmark" (links to webinar landing).

dan: Uploaded wireframe frames and the micro-tile templates. Ping me for tweaks. :eyes:

maria: Perfect. If we get comps earlier we can use them for a quick pre-launch social post.

figma-bot: Comment added on frame 3 by dan: "Need final KPI numbers from marketing"

maria: I'll paste final numbers and approve the animation spec by Thu morning.

done: end of thread
